policy: Each loop decides on its own record whether a candidate clears its gate; this file only reports those decisions, verbatim. transitions is append-only.

loops.name: Game model parameters
loops.learns: every FINAL game 2022-25 + each graded 2026 lock
loops.why: NEVER REGRESS: best off-grid candidate {'hfa_elo': 41.875, 'revert': 0.43125} scores 0.706814 HELD-OUT vs incumbent (hfa_elo=45.0 revert=0.450) at 0.660708 across 5 folds over n=63 resolved locks; the 0.0015 margin is not cleared, so the incumbent params are kept unchanged. should_adopt == false.

loops.name: Game signal weights (promotion gate)
loops.moves: the venue / cold signal weights in game odds
loops.why: incumbent retained: no candidate cleared the margin — signals stay at weight 0

loops.name: Player signal weights
loops.why: the refit is worse on held-out week(s) [2]

loops.name: Weekly split (player points per week)
loops.why: v2 beats v1 on pooled MAE (6.003 vs 6.050) and pooled rank_corr (0.381 vs 0.369); held-out 2025 MAE 6.079 vs 6.111

loops.name: Kicker / D-ST weekly split
loops.why: split beats flat by 0.1191, 95% CI [-0.1624, -0.0758] excludes 0

loops.name: Parlay leg calibration (wide pool)
loops.why: wide refit is better calibrated (ECE 0.0066 vs 0.0723, margin 0.005), keeps skill (0.1758 vs 0.1427) and carries information (skill > 0.02)

loops.name: Parlay leg calibration (2026 layer)
loops.why: hold: 1 held-out week(s) so far (weeks [2, 3] graded); the layer ships only on >= 2

loops.name: Slate prop calibration
loops.moves: prop legs on the slate parlays
loops.why: calibrated log-loss <= seed on every fold: 2024: 0.6767 vs 0.6920; 2025: 0.6705 vs 0.6820

loops.name: Spread cover model
loops.moves: spread legs (flat until it shows an edge)
loops.why: cover model log-loss 0.7231 vs a coin flip 0.6931 over 797 games — no edge, spreads stay priced flat

loops.name: Anytime-TD model
loops.why: ADOPTED — beats the position base rate and opportunity-only share on log loss and Brier in every held-out season (2023, 2024, 2025), calibration slope inside [0.9, 1.1] in each; team TDs within 5% over 2024-25

loops.name: Same-game card pricer
loops.learns: held-out seasons of simulated same-game cards
loops.moves: GAME anytime-TD card prices and sizes
loops.why: held-out log-loss joint 0.091365 vs independent 0.091129 over 43528 cards — the independent product keeps pricing them

loops.name: Backup-QB effect
loops.why: phase 1 measures only; 2 of 10 candidates clear never-regress (best by pooled MAE: cap_gap_RB)

loops.name: Rain and wind
loops.why: not powered: 1 of 10 measured effects have the sample to detect the effect of interest; 0 candidate(s) adoptable

loops.name: QB depth chart
loops.why: verdict none: no candidate clears the one-sided test at alpha 0.05 over 4 families

loops.name: Offensive / defensive line injuries
loops.why: phase 1 measures only; 0 of 15 variants clear never-regress

loops.name: Replay lab (parlay rules)
loops.why: candidate parlay rules replayed on 4 week(s): same pool_calibration, seed, shrink_to_half, spread_margin_model
